name: Malacca
tagline: A crossroads of empires on the Malacca Strait
summary: Malacca is a UNESCO port city layered with Malay, Portuguese, Dutch, British and Chinese history. Its red Dutch square, Peranakan shophouses on Jonker Street and riverside walks make it Malaysia's most historic weekend escape.
seasonNote: Warm and humid all year. Weekends and holidays are crowded; Jonker Street night market is Friday to Sunday.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus from Kuala Lumpur.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; trishaws (decorated, noisy) and Grab.
cashTip: Cards and Grab work widely; carry ringgit for night markets and hawker stalls.
foodTip: Chicken rice balls, Nyonya laksa and cendol.
buyTip: Peranakan beaded shoes and antiques on Jonker Street.
